Data Centre Expansion Faces Calls for Moratoriums

Calls for a halt to the construction of large-scale data centres have emerged from political groups in different regions. In Scotland, the Green Party is urging Members of the Scottish Parliament (MSPs) to vote for a moratorium on hyperscale data centres. Similarly, in Saskatchewan, Canada, the New Democratic Party (NDP) has called for a moratorium on large-scale AI data centres. These requests highlight concerns regarding the expansion of data centre infrastructure.
